title: Install reuse enforcement layer across Symbio, WIP, and Pen
reason: Requirements, plan, and GitHub handoff are real. Runtime execution still requires Pen/Bridge receipt before COMPLETE.
top_level_requirement: Stop duplicate builds without inhibiting speed, innovation, experimentation, or Golden Autonomous Loop execution.

original_need_covered.leak: Same capability, different names, rebuilt multiple times across brands, products, tools, and agents.
original_need_covered.fix: Standing reuse enforcement layer across Symbio dev, WIP intake, and Pen promotion.
must_not_do: Do not create a bureaucracy layer.
Do not turn reuse into manual approval theatre.
Do not allow duplicate capability to coexist under different names.
must_do: Intercept every incoming code, idea, draft, job, agent proposal, product proposal, workflow, Commercial Widget, and promotion request.
Compare against canonical registry, existing AGL flows, workers, queues, evidence paths, Command Centre surfaces, and Commercial Widgets.
Classify as FULL_MATCH, PARTIAL_MATCH, NET_NEW, or UNCLEAR_NEEDS_REVIEW.
Force reuse-first route when there is any viable attach path.
Create refactor/merge jobs where overlap exists.
Update registry and Commercial Widget definitions as part of closure.
Emit evidence and receipts for all decisions.

boundary_rules: WIP captures everything and never suppresses ideas.
Symbio can build and test freely, but must log reuse classification and attach recommendations.
Pen is the hard control point for promotion only.
Net-new path is explicit and fast when proof shows no attach path.
False blocks are reversible through GATED override with evidence.
Post-build sweeps catch misses without stopping current flow.
what_would_break_it: Hard-blocking Symbio experiments before evidence exists.
Manual human approval for every classification.

control_points.intent: Map to reuse and AGL attach points while preserving experimentation.
control_points.blocked: No promotion path without reuse record.

control_points.intent: Prevent duplicate promotion and registry drift.
control_points.allowed: Promote only with reuse classification, fit plan, registry update, and evidence.
control_points.blocked: Duplicate, unclassified, stale registry, missing evidence, missing closure definition.

agent_roles.action: Scan incoming work against registry, Commercial Widgets, workers, queues, processes, evidence paths, and prior builds.
Map capability into existing AGL flows: runtime queue, worker, evidence hook, closure register, CC widget/snippet, registry object, CW definition.
agent_roles.outcome: Extend existing system instead of rebuilding.

agent_roles.action: Block promotion if equivalent capability exists or reuse classification is missing.
Raise merge/refactor/archive jobs when overlap is found.
agent_roles.output: runtime.work_queue job with canonical target object.
agent_roles.outcome: Duplicates collapse into one canonical unit.

agent_roles.action: Update ops.system_registry and Commercial Widget definitions before closure.
agent_roles.output: registry update evidence and reality ledger binding.

agent_roles.action: Ensure reuse checks recommend and route without suppressing ideation or early experiments.
agent_roles.output: speed_impact and innovation_impact fields on classification.
agent_roles.outcome: Reuse control improves velocity rather than becoming bureaucracy.

agent_roles.action: Continuously detect naming drift, capability overlap, orphaned code, stale registry links, and abandoned duplicate builds.
agent_roles.outcome: Long-term coherence across 30-50 businesses and 200+ surfaces.

schemas_required.purpose: Canonical record of reuse decision per incoming object.
required_columns: match_type text not null check in FULL_MATCH/PARTIAL_MATCH/NET_NEW/UNCLEAR_NEEDS_REVIEW
created_at timestamptz not null default now()
updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
action_type text not null check in MERGE/EXTEND/ARCHIVE/BLOCK/NET_NEW_APPROVED/REVIEW
created_at timestamptz not null default now()
updated_at timestamptz not null default now()

schemas_required.purpose: Hard Pen blocks caused by duplicate or missing reuse evidence.
required_columns: created_at timestamptz not null default now()
updated_at timestamptz not null default now()

rls_and_integrity: Enable RLS on all new ops tables.
Service role and approved worker role can insert/update.
Authenticated read only where Command Centre requires visibility.
All writes require object_key, timestamp, evidence_state, and rationale.
Use idempotency key to prevent duplicate rows for same source object/run.

execution_steps.name: Bootstrap and constraint load
actions: Read global/GLOBAL_RULE.md
Read global/ENFORCEMENT_LIVE.md
Read global/CLAUDE_CONTAINER_CONSTRAINT.md
Read global/NO_MCP_GITHUB_CONNECTOR.md
Read docs/AGL_CONTROL_PLANE.md
Read global/ACTOR_BOOTSTRAP.md
execution_steps.acceptance: Worker confirms bridge-first, queue-first, no fake receipt, no direct ad hoc execution.

execution_steps.name: Create/patch reuse schema
actions: Apply idempotent migration for ops.reuse_classification.
Apply idempotent migration for ops.reuse_actions.
Apply idempotent migration for ops.duplication_blocks.
Add indexes and RLS policies.
Bind evidence to audit.evidence_register and audit.reality_ledger.
execution_steps.acceptance: Migration re-runs safely and tables prove PK/RLS/timestamps/indexes.

execution_steps.name: Install WIP ingress reuse check
actions: Intercept incoming ideas, pasted code, job drafts, product drafts, CW proposals, and agent requests.
Classify but do not block.
Return attach suggestions early.
execution_steps.acceptance: WIP capture remains unrestricted and writes classification/evidence.

execution_steps.name: Install Symbio pre-build reuse mapping
actions: Run reuse analyst before build job starts.
Run fit mapper to find AGL attach path.
If FULL/PARTIAL match, route to EXTEND/MERGE rather than REBUILD unless explicitly justified.
Allow experimental branch to continue but mark promotion blocked until resolved.
execution_steps.acceptance: Symbio experiments are not stopped, but promotion readiness includes reuse evidence.

execution_steps.name: Install Pen promotion hard gate
actions: Reject promotion if reuse classification missing.
Reject promotion if FULL_MATCH unresolved.
Require integration plan for PARTIAL_MATCH.
Require net-new proof bundle for NET_NEW.
Require registry/CW update before COMPLETE.
execution_steps.acceptance: Duplicate promotion fails closed with ops.duplication_blocks evidence.

execution_steps.name: Install refactor and merge queue
actions: Create runtime.work_queue jobs for merge/refactor/archive actions.
Attach source object, duplicate object, canonical target, owner, rollback path, evidence required.
Never delete first; archive only after evidence and Gatekeeper approval where risky.
execution_steps.acceptance: Overlap generates actionable queue job, not a vague note.

execution_steps.name: Install continuous sweeps
actions: duplication_sweep hourly across recent builds/jobs/registry changes.
cw_overlap_scan daily across Commercial Widgets.
orphan_capability_scan daily across code, jobs, and surfaces.
naming_drift_check per deploy/promotion.
execution_steps.acceptance: Sweeps write gap_register rows, evidence rows, and work_queue jobs.

execution_steps.name: Command Centre visibility
actions: Expose reuse status widget/snippet in cc.*.
Show blocked promotions, net-new approvals, duplicate clusters, pending refactors, registry drift.
Display REAL/PARTIAL/PRETEND state.
execution_steps.acceptance: Operator can see current reuse health without reading logs.

execution_steps.name: Smoke tests
actions: Submit sample FULL_MATCH object and prove Pen blocks promotion.
Submit sample PARTIAL_MATCH object and prove integration plan is created.
Submit sample NET_NEW object and prove proof bundle is required but path remains open.
Submit sample false-block override and prove GATED evidence path works.
Run one sweep and prove gap/work_queue/evidence writes.
execution_steps.acceptance: All smoke tests produce receipts/runtime entries and audit evidence.

execution_steps.name: Final reality binding
actions: Write initial accepted receipt.
Write execution receipt after smoke tests.
Update audit.reality_ledger to REAL only after runtime proof.
If any runtime proof missing, remain PARTIAL and report exact blocker.
execution_steps.acceptance: No COMPLETE without second receipt, Supabase evidence, and smoke test proof.

decision_rules: No build or promotion can reach COMPLETE without reuse classification.
No Pen promotion proceeds with missing reuse evidence.
FULL_MATCH means merge/extend/archive path, not new promoted capability.
PARTIAL_MATCH means produce an integration plan and gap list.
NET_NEW means prove no viable attach path exists.
UNCLEAR_NEEDS_REVIEW means log and hold at Pen, not WIP.
Duplicate capability equals merge, extend, archive, or kill; never silent coexistence.
Canonical naming comes from ops.system_registry only.
Innovation is protected by WIP/Symbio freedom and Pen-only hard gate.
success_metrics: 100 percent of promoted builds have reuse classification.
100 percent of Pen promotions have registry/CW fit check.
Average time-to-value decreases through extension over rebuild.

failure_handling.rollback: GATED override with evidence and rationale.
failure_handling.next: Tune thresholds and add counterexample to classifier.
Merge into canonical unit and update registry.

failure_handling.rollback: Lock affected object and force registry sync.
Mark PRETEND and re-run idempotent job.
Move hard gate back to Pen only and downgrade WIP/Symbio to log/recommend.
failure_handling.next: Measure classification latency and false-block rate.

done_definition: GitHub handoff exists and is fetch-verified.
Pen/Bridge accepts the job and writes initial receipt.
Schema exists with PK, timestamps, indexes, and RLS.
Fit mapper produces AGL attach plan.
Pen gate blocks missing/duplicate reuse evidence.
Registry updater writes canonical registry/CW changes.
At least one scheduled sweep runs and writes evidence/gaps/jobs.
Command Centre visibility exists or a gap is logged with owner and closure path.
Reality ledger is REAL only after runtime proof.
